com.epitech.depthdiablo.engine - package com.epitech.depthdiablo.engine

Observer: the event bus, its listeners and the game events, delivered once per tick.

com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character - package com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character
Characters: the shared character base, the playable heroes and their evade.

com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.projectile - package com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.projectile

com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.spawn - package com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.spawn
Spawning: builds players and enemies from data/characters.json and reloads their stats.
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.stats - package com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.stats
Stats: the stat names, where their values come from and the build that items modify.
com.epitech.depthdiablo.geometry - package com.epitech.depthdiablo.geometry
Collision shapes: axis-aligned boxes for bodies and oriented boxes for swings and hitboxes.
com.epitech.depthdiablo.input - package com.epitech.depthdiablo.input
What the user asks for, without the device behind it.
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item - package com.epitech.depthdiablo.item
Items: weapons, armor, consumables, passive items, inventory and loot tables.
com.epitech.depthdiablo.level - package com.epitech.depthdiablo.level
Levels: Tiled floors, the BSP + loops generator and the LevelGenerator role.
com.epitech.depthdiablo.loot - package com.epitech.depthdiablo.loot
Loot: what monsters drop, the loot table it is drawn from and the items lying on the floor.
com.epitech.depthdiablo.random - package com.epitech.depthdiablo.random
 
com.epitech.depthdiablo.shop - package com.epitech.depthdiablo.shop
Shop: the shopkeeper, the vending slots and the roulette.
